source.author: ov
source.text: Raptor agit currus et nomine quemque vocando exhortatur equos, quorum per colla iubasque excutit obscura tinctas ferrugine habenas, perque lacus altos et olentia sulphure fertur stagna Palicorum, rupta fervenu terra, et qua Bacchiadae, bimari gens orta Corintho, inter inaequales posuerunt moenia portus.
source.text_original: Raptor agit currus et nomine quemque vocando / exhortatur equos, quorum per colla iubasque / excutit obscura tinctas ferrugine habenas, / perque lacus altos et olentia sulphure fertur / stagna Palicorum, rupta fervenu terra, / et qua Bacchiadae, bimari gens orta Corintho, / inter inaequales posuerunt moenia portus.
source.text_english: The charioteer drives the chariot and, calling each horse by name, urges them on, and over whose necks and manes he shakes the reins, darkened and dyed with iron-gray, and he is borne through the deep lakes and the reeking pools of the Palici, the earth having broken open with heat, and where the Bacchiadae, a people sprung from bi-maritime Corinth, set their walls between unequal harbors.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: at frater magnos Lynceus servatur in usus, quem tulit Arene, possit qui rumpere terras et Styga transmisso tacitam deprendere visu.
reuse.text_original: at frater magnos Lynceus servatur in usus, / quem tulit Arene, possit qui rumpere terras / et Styga transmisso tacitam deprendere visu.
reuse.text_english: but their brother Lynceus is preserved for great uses, whom Arene bore, who can split the earth and, with his sight sent across, detect silent Styx.
